task.title: Authenticate to the VPN With Duo
task.shortdesc: How can you authenticate to the VPN using Duo Push, SMS passcodes, bypass codes, and other approved authentication methods.

context.p: The NC State Office of Information Technology (OIT) requires all students, faculty, and staff to authenticate with Duo Security when signing in to the VPN. When connecting through Cisco Secure Client, use the Second Password field to complete second-factor verification using one of the approved methods below.
context.note: Hardware security keys and U2F tokens cannot be used directly inside the VPN client prompt. If you only use a security key or U2F token, generate a 9-digit passcode through the Duo One-Time Passcode Tool at go.ncsu.edu/dc or request a bypass code from the OIT Help Desk.

step.cmd: Open Cisco Secure Client, connect to vpn.ncsu.edu, and enter your Unity ID and password.
Complete the Second Password field using one of the following approved Duo authentication methods:

substep.cmd: Duo Push: Type push in the Second Password field, select OK, and tap Approve on the notification sent to your Duo Mobile app.
Duo Mobile App Passcode: Open the Duo Mobile app, select Duo Protected – NC State University, enter the 6-digit passcode into the Second Password field, and select OK.

SMS Text Message Passcode: Type sms in the Second Password field and select OK (the initial attempt will report that it failed while sending a text code). Re-enter your Unity ID and password, enter the 7-digit code texted to your phone into the Second Password field, and select OK.

Duo One-Time Passcode Tool (Security Key / U2F users): Go to go.ncsu.edu/dc, sign in with your Unity ID and password, verify with your Security Key or U2F token, select Generate New Passcode, and enter the 9-digit code in the Second Password field.

Duo Bypass Code: Call the NC State OIT Help Desk at 919-515-4357 (available 24/7) or visit the Walk-in Center to verify your identity and receive a 9-digit bypass code, then enter that 9-digit code in the Second Password field and select OK.
